Without it the runner exits before dispatching anything, leaving both DSFSTG-3 assertions at 0. I cannot create files; the fix must be a code change that adds the fixture.

lens-correctness-code finding 2: wrong — RQLOOP-1 requires that the interrupted iteration and member state are restored correctly, not that every internal guard path is covered. The DSCMBR-1 test sets `stage_statuses.test = "aborted"` deliberately because "aborted" is the status `_cycle_state_write_member_atomic` actually writes for an interrupted member; the test exercises the production data shape. The 'all-complete' pre-scan edge case (Scenario A/B distinction) is an internal correctness guard not named by any ISSUE REQUIREMENT. The gap is future debt, not an unmet requirement under this issue.
